profile.visual_desc: Bipedal green-scaled draconian with large wings. Wears silver-grey plate armor with spiked pauldrons over a dark blue tunic and waistcloth.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Profile of a green reptilian head facing left. Features a sharp yellow slitted eye, prominent brow spikes, and visible white fangs.
profile.weapon_desc: A heavy, conical silver lance-sword held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing ↖. Stands with wings tucked; right hand holds the lance pointed downward and back.
profile.step2_windup: Crouches and shifts weight forward. Levels the lance toward the target as golden light begins to glow at the tip.
profile.step3_impact: Performs a full-body thrust ↖. A large, jagged golden energy beam erupts from the lance tip, extending horizontally toward the target.
profile.step4_finish: Lunges forward into a low follow-through pose. The golden energy trail dissipates as the unit returns to a standing position.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The horizontal golden energy beam in Frame 4 correctly follows the linear trajectory of the lance thrust toward the upper-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation follows reference logic and directional windup. VFX alignment is correct, though late frames show layering and cropping artifacts.
